# Catherine Andrews

## Overview

- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Personality

Catherine Andrews maintains an optimistic outlook on life, preferring to look on the bright side of situations. She demonstrates an encouraging attitude toward others' endeavors and expresses a strong belief in their potential to do good.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P21](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0021), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P31](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0031)_

## History

During a canvassing trip for the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) visited the Andrews house. After the pessimistic [Eliza](../character/eliza-andrews.md) refused to make a donation, Catherine secretly ran out to give them her egg money.

_Sources: [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P0](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0000), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P12](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0012), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P16](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0016), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P30](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0030)_
